seller.description: Ondato is a Lithuania-founded, UK-headquartered SaaS company (Ondato OS) providing KYC, AML, KYB, identity verification, age verification, authentication and due-diligence tools that let businesses onboard and monitor customers across 192 countries with 10,000+ supported document types, ~99.8% verification accuracy and about 30-second average onboarding.

icp.offer: Identity verification and age assurance (KYC / age-check) sold as a conversion product — fast (about 30-second) onboarding, ~97% average pass rate, 192-country and 10,000+ document-type coverage. Transaction monitoring (KYT) is explicitly out of scope for this motion.
icp.buyer: Growth-side decision-makers, not compliance: CRO, Chief Growth Officer, CMO, Chief Product Officer, Head of Growth, Head of Product, Head of Business Development, or the Founder/CEO, at companies in the United Kingdom & Ireland, United States, or Canada. Compliance, risk, legal or MLRO titles must never be targeted.

anyOf.text: Company serves consumers or SMBs in the United Kingdom and Ireland
Company serves consumers or SMBs in the United States
Company serves consumers or SMBs in Canada
Company is a fintech
Company is a neobank or digital bank
Company is a payments company or PSP
Company is a lending company
Company is a trading or investment app
Company is a crypto exchange or wallet
Company is an age-gated platform (adult content, gambling, gaming, social, dating, vaping, or alcohol e-commerce)
Company has raised between $2M and $250M in funding
Company has between $1M and $150M in revenue
Company is privately held and reachable for outbound (public companies and larger groups are excluded as named accounts outside this motion)
Company is not itself a KYC, identity-verification, or age-verification vendor or direct competitor
Company is not a compliance consultancy, agency, or non-profit
Company runs high-volume digital signups where identity assurance functions as a revenue enabler
Announced a new market entry or a fresh e-money, banking, lending or payments license with a go-live in a new jurisdiction (UK, EU, US, or Canada)
anyOf.sourceRule: Situation must be proven by a page

anyOf.text: Users publicly complain in app store or Trustpilot reviews about failed, stuck, or slow identity verification at signup
anyOf.sourceRule: Must be shown in app store or Trustpilot reviews; situation must be proven by a page

anyOf.text: Announced or launched a consumer product that needs new users to verify identity or age at signup (new app, wallet, card, account type, or trading feature)
anyOf.sourceRule: Situation must be proven by a page

anyOf.text: Is an age-gated platform serving UK or US users exposed to the UK Online Safety Act's age assurance duty or US state age-verification laws
anyOf.sourceRule: Shown by its own compliance statement or enforcement coverage; situation must be proven by a page

anyOf.text: Raised a funding round with stated user-growth or expansion plans
anyOf.sourceRule: Situation must be proven by a page
